title: MZ Can someone help with VisuMZ OptionCore

posts.body:

Pixel Perfect Scaling Mode
Pixel Perfect Scaling Mode 1.2.1 Galenmereth  Introduction This plugins enables pixel-perfect scaling in RPG Maker MV and MZ, without any configuration. Optionally you can enable an in-game option menu addition so that your players can toggle it off or on. The label for this menu option is...

So can anyone help add a command to enable or disable any of these plugins in general category of Visu OptionCore? I don't care which one is easier to help with. both have a built-in option to show them in the options,  but none of them are showing because OptionCore is on
